Home
Chemical Transfer Pumps & Metered Chemical Transfer Solutions

At RotoZest Industries, we design and supply reliable chemical transfer pumps for industries across India. Our pumps handle chemicals safely and efficiently, whether you need simple fluid transfer or precise metered delivery.
We also offer chemical transfer pumps, giving you consistent flow and controlled operation. You can rely on these pumps to improve productivity and reduce chemical waste.
Our Range of Pumps
Rotary Gear Pumps
As a leading rotary gear pump manufacturer in Ahmedabad, we produce pumps that combine durability with precision. Our rotary gear pumps fit a wide range of industrial applications.
SS Rotary Gear Pump : Made of stainless steel, these pumps resist corrosion and suit aggressive chemicals.
Cast Iron Rotary Gear Pump : These heavy-duty pumps handle high-viscosity fluids and demanding operations.
You can choose a pump based on your chemical type, flow requirements, and application needs.
Chemical Transfer Pumps with Motor

Our chemical transfer pumps with motor ensure smooth operation without manual effort. They deliver chemicals at a controlled rate, reducing errors and improving safety. These pumps work well in pharmaceutical, chemical, and food-processing industries.
Why RotoZest Industries
Nationwide Supplier : We are a trusted supplier in all of India, providing pumps wherever you operate.
Reliable Performance : Every pump undergoes rigorous testing for safety and consistency.
Expert Guidance : Our team helps you choose the right pump for your specific application.
Customizable Options : We can tailor pumps to meet unique operational requirements.
“RotoZest pumps combine efficiency and reliability, helping industries maintain smooth operations and reduce downtime.” – Industry Expert
